value.rationale: The canonical analytic/co-analytic splitting fails at the ordinary harmonic h1 endpoint, as shown by an explicit Poisson-kernel example. The recent source needs such splitting in its p>1 Littlewood-Paley argument. Proving that the weak quasiregular differential inequality restores component-wise H1 membership at exactly p=1 isolates a substantive endpoint mechanism and supplies a quantitative tool for further endpoint work.
